title: The Three Little Pigs
moral: A strong house is built carefully, one piece at a time.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md §3-4). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 voice_script_en.json 의 en 그대로, trim 은 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.fan:blow:<straw|wood|brick> | pile:drop:: 가게 바람·재료 떨어뜨리기(drop)·집 완성(reveal)·집 무너짐·마을 새 집
acts.wolf:blow:<n> | fire:big | pot:boil | pi: 늑대 입김 n번·불 키우기·솥 끓기·돼지들 달리기

lines.text: 옛날 옛날에 아기 돼지 삼 형제가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, three little pigs lived together.
segs: Once upon a time, three little pigs lived together.

lines.text: 첫째는 피리를 삐리리, 둘째는 바이올린을 깽깽, 셋째는 책을 읽는 걸 좋아했지요.
lines.en: The first pig loved to toot his flute, the second loved to scrape his violin, and the third loved to read.
segs: The first pig loved to toot his flute, the second loved to scrape his violin, and the third loved to read.

lines.text: 풀밭에 엄마 돼지와 삼 형제가 모였어요.
lines.en: Mama Pig and the three brothers gathered in the meadow.
segs: Mama Pig and the three brothers gathered in the meadow.

lines.text: 엄마 돼지가 말했어요. "이제 너희도 다 컸구나. 세상에 나가서 각자 집을 지어 보렴."
lines.en: Mother Pig said. You are all grown up now. Go out into the world and build a house of your own.
segs: You are all grown up now. Go out into the world and build a house of your own.

lines.text: "튼튼하게 지어야 한다!" 엄마 돼지는 삼 형제를 꼭 안아 주었어요.
lines.en: "Build them strong, my dears!" Mother Pig gave her three little pigs a big, tight hug.
segs: Mother Pig gave her three little pigs a big, tight hug.

lines.text: 삼 형제는 엄마께 인사하고 길을 떠났어요.
lines.en: The three brothers said goodbye to Mother and set off on the road.
segs: The three brothers said goodbye to Mother and set off on the road.

lines.text: 셋은 나란히 총총, 신나게 걸어갔어요.
lines.en: Off they went, side by side, trot, trot, trot, happy as could be.
segs: Off they went, side by side, trot, trot, trot, happy as could be.

lines.text: 삼 형제는 집 지을 재료를 사러 가게에 갔어요.
lines.en: The three brothers went to the shop to buy things to build with.
segs: The three brothers went to the shop to buy things to build with.

lines.text: 짚 한 묶음, 나무 한 더미, 벽돌 한 무더기가 나란히 있었지요.
lines.en: There was a bundle of straw, a pile of wood, and a heap of bricks, all in a row.
segs: There was a bundle of straw, a pile of wood, and a heap of bricks, all in a row.

lines.text: 가게에서 바람을 불어 보기로 했어요.
lines.en: At the shop, they decided to try blowing wind.
segs: At the shop, they decided to try blowing wind.

lines.text: 짚은 훨훨 날아가요. 아주 가벼워요.
lines.en: Straw flies away. It is very light.
segs: Straw flies away. It is very light.

lines.text: 나무는 흔들흔들! 조금 튼튼해요.
lines.en: Wood wobbles! It is a little bit strong.
segs: Wood wobbles! It is a little bit strong.

lines.text: 벽돌은 끄떡없어요! 아주 아주 튼튼해요.
lines.en: Bricks don't budge! They are very, very strong.
segs: Bricks don't budge! They are very, very strong.

lines.text: 가게를 떠난 첫째가 집 지을 터에 도착했어요.
lines.en: The oldest pig left the shop and reached his building spot.
segs: The oldest pig left the shop and reached his building spot.

lines.text: 첫째는 짚으로 집을 짓기로 했어요.
lines.from: 첫째는 짚으로 집을 짓기로 했어요. 짚을 톡톡톡 쌓아요!
lines.en: The first pig decided to build with straw.
segs: The first pig decided to build with straw.

lines.text: 사락사락, 짚을 휘리릭 얹으니 금방이었어요.
lines.en: Swish, swish, he tossed the straw on, and it was done in a jiffy.
segs: Swish, swish, he tossed the straw on, and it was done in a jiffy.

lines.text: 뚝딱! 짚 집이 완성됐어요. 첫째는 피리를 불며 놀았어요.
lines.en: Ta-da! The straw house is done. The first pig played his flute.
segs: Ta-da! The straw house is done. The first pig played his flute.

lines.text: 그동안 둘째도 자기 집 지을 터에 도착했어요.
lines.en: Meanwhile, the middle pig reached his own building spot.
segs: Meanwhile, the middle pig reached his own building spot.

lines.text: 둘째는 나무로 집을 짓기로 했어요.
lines.from: 둘째는 나무로 집을 짓기로 했어요. 망치로 톡톡톡톡톡!
lines.en: The second pig decided to build with wood.
segs: The second pig decided to build with wood.

lines.text: 뚝딱뚝딱, 망치질 몇 번에 나무 집이 뚝딱 섰어요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, bang, bang, a few swings of the hammer and up went the wood house.
segs: Tap, tap, bang, bang, a few swings of the hammer and up went the wood house.

lines.text: 쿵쾅쿵쾅! 나무 집이 완성됐어요. 둘째는 바이올린을 켜며 놀았어요.
lines.en: Bang, bang! The wood house is done. The second pig played his violin.
segs: Bang, bang! The wood house is done. The second pig played his violin.

lines.text: 셋째도 자기 집 지을 터로 벽돌을 날랐어요.
lines.en: The youngest pig carried bricks to his own building spot.
segs: The youngest pig carried bricks to his own building spot.

lines.text: 셋째는 벽돌로 집을 짓기로 했어요. 벽돌은 무거워서 열 장을 천천히 쌓아요.
lines.en: The third pig decided to build with bricks. Bricks are heavy, so stack ten of them slowly.
segs: The third pig decided to build with bricks. Bricks are heavy, so stack ten of them slowly.

lines.text: 영차, 영차. 셋째는 땀을 뻘뻘 흘리며 벽돌을 한 장씩 쌓았어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho. The third pig stacked the bricks one at a time, dripping with sweat.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho. The third pig stacked the bricks one at a time, dripping with sweat.

lines.text: 형들이 놀렸어요. "아직도 해? 우리랑 놀자!" 그래도 셋째는 천천히 벽돌을 쌓았어요.
lines.en: His brothers teased him. Still building? Come and play with us! But the third pig kept stacking bricks, slowly.
segs: Still building? Come and play with us!
But the third pig kept stacking bricks, slowly.

lines.text: "튼튼하게 짓는 게 제일 중요해!" 셋째는 씩씩하게 말했어요.
lines.en: "Building it strong is what matters most!" the third pig said bravely.
segs: Building it strong is what matters most!

lines.text: 벽돌을 열 장 다 쌓았어요. 튼튼한 벽돌 집이 완성됐어요!
lines.en: He stacked all ten bricks. A strong brick house is done!
segs: He stacked all ten bricks. A strong brick house is done!

lines.text: 첫째는 짚 집에서 놀고 있었어요.
lines.en: The oldest pig was playing at his straw house.
segs: The oldest pig was playing at his straw house.

lines.text: 그때 배고픈 늑대가 킁킁 냄새를 맡으며 왔어요. "아기 돼지야, 문 열어라!"
lines.en: Then a hungry wolf came along, sniff, sniff. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
segs: Then a hungry wolf came along, sniff, sniff.
Little pig, little pig, open the door!

lines.text: 첫째가 말했어요. "싫어요, 싫어요!" 늑대가 말했어요. "그럼 후~ 불어서 날려 버릴 테야!"
lines.en: The first pig said. No, no, no! The wolf said. Then I'll huff and puff and blow it away!
segs: Then I'll huff and puff and blow it away!

lines.text: 늑대는 볼을 빵빵하게 부풀렸어요. 후우~!
lines.en: The wolf puffed up his cheeks, big and round. Whoosh~!
segs: The wolf puffed up his cheeks, big and round. Whoosh~!

lines.text: 짚 집이 훨훨 날아가 버렸어요!
lines.en: The straw house flew away!

lines.text: 첫째는 둘째네 집으로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The first pig ran to his brother's house.
segs: The first pig ran to his brother's house.

lines.text: 첫째가 나무 집 안으로 후다닥 들어갔어요.
lines.en: The oldest pig hurried into the wooden house.
segs: The oldest pig hurried into the wooden house.

lines.text: 늑대가 나무 집에도 왔어요. "아기 돼지야, 문 열어라!"
lines.en: Then the wolf came to the wood house too. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
segs: Then the wolf came to the wood house too.
Little pig, little pig, open the door!

lines.text: 첫째와 둘째가 말했어요. "싫어요, 싫어요!" 늑대가 말했어요. "그럼 후~ 후~ 불어 주지!"
lines.en: The first and second pigs said. No, no, no! The wolf said. Then I'll huff and puff and blow it down!
segs: The first and second pigs said.
Then I'll huff and puff and blow it down!

lines.text: 후~ 후~! 나무 집이 삐걱삐걱 흔들리더니…
lines.en: Huff! Puff! The wood house creaked and wobbled, and then...
segs: Huff! Puff! The wood house creaked and wobbled, and then...

lines.text: 나무 집이 와르르 무너졌어요!
lines.en: The wood house tumbled down!

lines.text: 아기 돼지 둘은 막내네 집으로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The two little pigs ran to their youngest brother's house.
segs: The two little pigs ran to their youngest brother's house.

lines.text: 두 형은 셋째의 벽돌 집 문 앞에 도착했어요.
lines.en: The two brothers reached the door of the youngest pig’s brick house.
segs: The two brothers reached the door of the youngest pig’s brick house.

lines.text: 두 형은 숨이 차서 헉헉!
lines.from: 두 형은 숨이 차서 헉헉! 어느 집으로 가야 할까요?
lines.en: The two brothers were out of breath, huff, puff!
segs: The two brothers were out of breath, huff, puff!

lines.text: 셋째가 문을 활짝 열어 주었어요. 형들은 후다닥 뛰어 들어갔지요.
lines.en: The third pig flung the door open wide. His brothers dashed inside, quick as a wink.
segs: The third pig flung the door open wide. His brothers dashed inside, quick as a wink.

lines.text: 삼 형제는 문을 꼭 닫고 빗장을 철컥 걸었어요.
lines.en: The three brothers shut the door tight and slid the bolt, click, clack.
segs: The three brothers shut the door tight and slid the bolt, click, clack.

lines.text: 삼 형제는 모두 모였어요.
lines.from: 삼 형제는 모두 모였어요. 하나, 둘, 셋을 세어 볼까요?
lines.en: All three brothers were together.

lines.text: "셋이서 함께라서 무섭지 않아!"
lines.en: We're together, all three. I'm not scared!
segs: We're together, all three. I'm not scared!

lines.text: 삼 형제가 숨은 벽돌 집 밖에서 발소리가 났어요.
lines.en: Footsteps sounded outside the brick house where the three brothers hid.
segs: Footsteps sounded outside the brick house where the three brothers hid.

lines.text: 늑대가 벽돌 집에 왔어요. "아기 돼지야, 문 열어라!"
lines.en: The wolf came to the brick house. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
segs: The wolf came to the brick house.
Little pig, little pig, open the door!

lines.text: "싫어요, 싫어요!" "그럼 후~ 후~ 불어 주지!"
lines.en: No, no, no! Then I'll huff and puff and blow!
segs: Then I'll huff and puff and blow!

lines.text: 후~ 후~ 후~! 늑대는 얼굴이 새빨개지도록 불고 또 불었어요.
lines.en: Huff, puff, huff, puff! The wolf blew and blew until his face turned bright red.
segs: Huff, puff, huff, puff! The wolf blew and blew until his face turned bright red.

lines.text: 후~ 후~ 여덟 번이나 불었지만 벽돌 집은 끄떡없어요!
lines.en: Huff, puff! He blew eight times, but the brick house did not budge!
segs: Huff, puff! He blew eight times, but the brick house did not budge!

lines.text: 늑대는 숨이 차서 털썩 주저앉았어요.
lines.en: The wolf was out of breath and plopped down.
segs: The wolf was out of breath and plopped down.

lines.text: "흥, 그럼 다른 수를 써야지!" 늑대는 눈을 데굴데굴 굴렸어요.
lines.en: "Hmph! Then I will try another way!" The wolf rolled his eyes around and around, thinking.
segs: Hmph! Then I will try another way!
The wolf rolled his eyes around and around, thinking.

lines.text: 늑대는 지붕으로 살금살금 올라갔어요. 굴뚝으로 몰래 들어가려고요.
lines.en: The wolf crept up onto the roof. He wanted to sneak in through the chimney.
segs: The wolf crept up onto the roof. He wanted to sneak in through the chimney.

lines.text: 지붕에서 바스락바스락 소리가 났어요. 삼 형제는 귀를 쫑긋 세웠지요.
lines.en: Rustle, rustle, came a sound from the roof. The three brothers pricked up their ears.
segs: Rustle, rustle, came a sound from the roof. The three brothers pricked up their ears.

lines.text: 집 안의 삼 형제는 굴뚝 아래에 솥을 놓았어요.
lines.en: Inside, the three brothers put a pot under the chimney.
segs: Inside, the three brothers put a pot under the chimney.

lines.text: 아기 돼지들은 큰 솥에 물을 팔팔 끓였어요.
lines.en: The little pigs boiled water in a big pot.
segs: The little pigs boiled water in a big pot.

lines.text: 장작을 넣자 불이 활활 타올랐어요.
lines.en: They tossed in more wood, and the fire blazed, crackle, crackle.
segs: They tossed in more wood, and the fire blazed, crackle, crackle.

lines.text: 보글보글 물이 끓어요! 그때 굴뚝에서 늑대가 쑥 내려왔어요.
lines.en: Bubble, bubble, the water is boiling! Then the wolf slid down the chimney.
segs: Bubble, bubble, the water is boiling! Then the wolf slid down the chimney.

lines.text: 늑대 엉덩이가 뜨거운 솥에 닿았어요.
lines.en: The wolf’s bottom touched the hot pot.
segs: The wolf’s bottom touched the hot pot.

lines.text: "앗, 뜨거워!"
lines.en: Ouch, it's hot!

lines.text: 늑대는 굴뚝으로 휙! 날아가서 멀리멀리 도망쳤어요. 다시는 오지 않았어요.
lines.en: The wolf whooshed up the chimney and ran far, far away. He never came back.
segs: The wolf whooshed up the chimney and ran far, far away. He never came back.

lines.text: 늑대가 떠난 뒤, 삼 형제는 집 밖으로 나왔어요.
lines.en: After the wolf left, the three brothers came outside.
segs: After the wolf left, the three brothers came outside.

lines.text: 이제 늑대는 오지 않아요. 아기 돼지들은 벽돌 집을 더 지었어요.
lines.en: The wolf never came again. The little pigs built more brick houses.
segs: The wolf never came again. The little pigs built more brick houses.

lines.text: 첫째도 둘째도 영차영차, 이번엔 벽돌을 한 장씩 차곡차곡 쌓았지요.
lines.en: The first and second pigs went heave-ho, heave-ho, stacking bricks one by one, neat and tidy.
segs: The first and second pigs went heave-ho, heave-ho, stacking bricks one by one, neat and tidy.

lines.text: 하나, 둘, 셋! 튼튼한 벽돌 집이 세 채가 되었어요.
lines.en: One, two, three! Now there were three strong brick houses.
segs: One, two, three! Now there were three strong brick houses.

lines.text: 저녁 해가 뉘엿뉘엿, 굴뚝에서는 연기가 모락모락 피어올랐어요.
lines.en: The evening sun sank low, and smoke curled up, puff, puff, from the chimneys.
segs: The evening sun sank low, and smoke curled up, puff, puff, from the chimneys.

lines.text: 삼 형제는 튼튼한 집에서 오래오래 행복하게 살았어요.
lines.en: The three brothers lived happily in their strong houses for a long, long time.
segs: The three brothers lived happily in their strong houses for a long, long time.

lines.text: 튼튼한 집은 하나씩 정성껏 쌓아서 만든답니다.
lines.en: A strong house is built carefully, one piece at a time.
segs: A strong house is built carefully, one piece at a time.
